_comment: Control for the rebasin+probe runs: few-shot linear probing of ONE CLIP model, with no rebasin, no source model, no task vector and no fine-tuned checkpoint anywhere. Run it with eval/vision_linear_probe.py (NOT vision_rebase.py): that entrypoint builds only the clip_model/clip_pretrained pair below and uses only that pretrain's own backbone and its own zero-shot heads.
_comparability: Keep clip_model/clip_pretrained equal to the TARGET of the rebasin runs (vision8_{steer,theseus,bico}_linear_probe.json), and linear_probe_shots_per_class / epochs / lr identical to theirs -- then the 'probed' number here is exactly what those runs have to beat, measured on the same backbone with the same probe budget.
_lr_note: linear_probe_lr must stay small relative to the head's own scale: rows are L2-normalized (entries ~1/sqrt(D)), and Adam's step is ~lr per coordinate regardless of gradient magnitude, so a large lr erases the zero-shot head in a couple of steps and the probe restarts from nothing. Watch the epoch-0 log line: it reproduces the zero-shot accuracy, and nothing after it should fall below.
